title: Windows: bazel query "//external:*" crashing [blocking: release 0.15.0]

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

Using Bazel built at HEAD crashes on `query "//external:*"`.

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

Build Bazel at a5ecd8132d3742831eda9730614270604294e410, then use that binary to run `devbazel.exe query "//external:*"`.

Output:

```

...........................
```

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

Windows 10

### If `bazel info release` returns "development version" or "(@non-git)", tell us how you built Bazel.

From a5ecd8132d3742831eda9730614270604294e410, using Bazel 0.13.1 release.
